title: RegisterProviderRequest
description: Provider self-registration request (§10). The apiKey is used only to call the provider's API and MUST never appear in any protocol response, log line or public listing.

adapter.description: API dialect of the provider: classic key+action panel API (smm-v2) or reseller-style REST v1 (Bearer auth, /services + /orders)

endpoint.description: Public https base URL of the provider API. Must pass the SSRF guard (§10.2).

apiKey.description: Provider-side credential. Never returned by the protocol.

displayName.description: Human-readable name; published only when publiclyListed is true

publiclyListed.description: Opt in to publishing displayName on the public provider showcase

payoutAddress.description: Direct-settlement address (§8). Becomes the payTo of this provider's payment requirements.
